note: Verification log for the design brief (task T50, session arena/dc72a69e-zone2). One row per check this session performed on 2026-11-16 UTC. 'result' is one of: match (the page served the text this project publishes), mismatch (it did not — raised as a flag), reproduced (a prior observation was re-run and came out the same), or measured (a count of this repository's own files, which no external page can settle). Sandbox shell curl fails outbound TLS, so every live check used fetch_page; no row rests on the shell's network. Every count was taken again on 2026-11-16 after rebasing onto main at 18e8de8, because session arena/9251f262-zone2 (T55) rebuilt the front pages and added the guides/ namespace while this session was in flight; VF-30's finding was resolved by that rebuild and is recorded as closed rather than deleted.
channel_note: Outbound TLS from the sandbox shell fails with SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL. Every live check below was therefore run with fetch_page or the GitHub API, and the channel is named on each row.
